## How it was checked

- [ ] `./gradlew ktlintCheck test lint :app:licensee assembleDebug` passes
- [ ] Tested on a device or emulator (say which), if it changes the app's behaviour
- [ ] Ported files carry their upstream header, and `docs/PORTING.md` is updated
- [ ] No stream keys, tokens, passwords or personal data in code, tests, logs or screenshots
